intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按恢复线记忆：firemen 和 forest fire 搏斗将近三周，火势终于 under control；great trees 变成 desolate hills；heavy rain 会 wash away the soil 并 cause floods；forest authorities 用 aeroplanes spray grass seed；最后 grass takes root，patches of green 出现在 blackened soil。读的时候注意 had been fighting、desolate、threatened、not only...but...as well、sprayed、aeroplanes、taken root 和 patches of green。

sentences.text: Firemen had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks before they could get it under control.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：消防员和森林大火搏斗了将近三周，最后才把火势控制住。Had been fighting 要读出持续很久，under control 连读自然。

sentences.text: A short time before, great trees had covered the countryside for miles around.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：不久之前，参天大树还覆盖着方圆数英里的乡野。A short time before 先停一下，had covered 表示过去中的更早过去。

sentences.text: Now, smoke still rose up from the warm ground over the desolate hills.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：现在，发热的地面上仍然升起烟雾，弥漫在荒凉山丘上。Now 和 A short time before 形成对比，desolate 三个音节不要读急。

sentences.text: Winter was coming on and the hills threatened the surrounding villages with destruction, for heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：冬天快来了，山丘威胁周围村庄，因为大雨不仅会冲走土壤，还会造成严重洪水。长句先分成 threat 和 reason 两段，not only 和 as well 要互相呼应。
focus_words: not only wash away the soil

sentences.text: When the fire had at last been put out, the forest authorities ordered several tons of a special type of grass-seed which would grow quickly.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：大火终于被扑灭后，森林管理部门订购了几吨能快速生长的草籽。Had at last been put out 是被动完成，authorities 这个长词可以轻轻分成几拍。
focus_words: had at last been put out

sentences.text: The seed was sprayed over the ground in huge quantities by aeroplanes.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：飞机把种子大量喷洒到地面上。Was sprayed 是被动，in huge quantities 表示大量地，aeroplanes 是英式拼写，按 airplanes 理解即可。

sentences.text: By then, however, in many places the grass had already taken root.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：然而到那时，许多地方的草已经扎根了。By then 后面稍停，had already taken root 要读出“雨来之前已经完成”的感觉。

sentences.text: In place of the great trees which had been growing there for centuries patches of green had begun to appear in the blackened soil.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：代替那些生长了几个世纪的大树，一片片绿色开始出现在烧黑的土壤上。In place of 是代替，patches of green 是希望的画面，blackened 读成两个音节。
